description:
As a customer, I want to search so I can find a tool quickly.

* A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
* A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
* Search is case-insensitive.
* Clearing the search restores the full product list.

Search matches product names (partial, case-insensitive)

criteria.text: A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
Clearing the search restores the full product list.

cases.title: Search term matching existing products lists only matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <at least one product whose name contains a known search term> and <at least one product whose name does not contain that term>.
steps: Enter <a search term contained in at least one product name> in the search field.
cases.expected: Only the products whose names match the search term are listed; products that do not match are not shown.

cases.title: Search term with no matches shows an empty state message and no error
cases.preconditions: The product list is populated and contains no product whose name contains <a term that matches no product name>.
steps: Enter <a term that matches no product name> in the search field.
cases.expected: An empty state message is displayed (exact wording not specified in the story). No products are listed and no error is shown.

cases.title: Search is case-insensitive (uppercase term)
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name contains lowercase letters>.
steps: Enter the search term using only uppercase letters, e.g. the name of <a product whose name contains lowercase letters> typed in uppercase.
cases.expected: The matching product(s) are listed, the same as when the term is typed in its original case.

cases.title: Search is case-insensitive (mixed/lowercase term)
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name contains uppercase letters>.
steps: Enter the name of <a product whose name contains uppercase letters> typed in lowercase or mixed case.
cases.expected: The matching product(s) are listed, the same as when the term is typed in its original case.

cases.title: Partial product name matches
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name contains a distinctive fragment, e.g. part of a word>.
steps: Enter only a fragment of the product name (not the full name) in the search field.
cases.expected: The product whose name contains that fragment is listed; products whose names do not contain the fragment are not listed.

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list is populated with <several products>.
steps: Open the product list and note the full list of products displayed.
Enter <a search term contained in at least one product name> and run the search.
cases.expected: The full product list is displayed again, matching the list noted in step 1.

cases.title: Clearing the search after a no-match search restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list is populated with <several products> and contains no product whose name contains <a term that matches no product name>.
steps: Open the product list and note the full list of products displayed.
Enter <a term that matches no product name> and run the search.
Confirm the empty state message is shown and no error appears.
cases.expected: The full product list is displayed again, matching the list noted in step 1.
